# Service events and prompt conditions

Read from the code: every public name below, its signature and its docstring. Import `igni_extension` — defined in `igni_extension.prompt`, `igni_extension.service_events`.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`PromptConditions`](#promptconditions) | The conditions this extension's prompt contributions wait on. |
| [`ServiceEvent`](#serviceevent) | One event from this extension's service. |

## PromptConditions

```python
class PromptConditions
PromptConditions(session: HostSession)
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session` | `HostSession` | required | The session to the igni host, which the conditions are sent on (`igni_extension.session`). |

The conditions this extension's prompt contributions wait on.

### PromptConditions.holding

```python
@property
holding: dict[str, bool]
```

What was last said, by condition.

### PromptConditions.hold()

```python
async def hold(condition: str, holds: bool = True) -> None
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | `str` | required | The condition's name, as the manifest writes it: `index-covers-head`. |
| `holds` | `bool` | `True` | Whether the condition is met now; `True` when it is. |

Say whether one condition holds. Saying the same again sends nothing.

### PromptConditions.set()

```python
async def set(conditions: dict[str, bool]) -> None
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conditions` | `dict[str, bool]` | required | What each condition now holds, by the name the manifest writes it under. |

Say several at once; only the ones that changed are sent.

### PromptConditions.refresh()

```python
async def refresh() -> None
```

Have igni fetch this extension's tool-sourced prompt text again.

## ServiceEvent

```python
class ServiceEvent(BaseModel)
ServiceEvent(
    *,
    event_id: str,
    extension_id: str = '',
    client_id: str = '',
    type: str,
    payload: dict[str, Any] = <factory>,
    event_key: str | None = None,
    created_at: str | None = None,
    expires_at: str | None = None,
    **extra_data: Any,
)
```

One event from this extension's service.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_id` | `str` | required | igni's id for it; a repeat has the same one. |
| `extension_id` | `str` | `''` | The extension it is for: this one. |
| `client_id` | `str` | `''` | The service that sent it (its client id). |
| `type` | `str` | required | The service's own word for what happened: `claim.created`. |
| `payload` | `dict[str, Any]` | factory | What the service sent with it. |
| `event_key` | `str \| None` | `None` | The key the service sent it with, if any: one event per key. |
| `created_at` | `str \| None` | `None` | When igni stored it, ISO 8601. |
| `expires_at` | `str \| None` | `None` | When igni stops trying to deliver it, ISO 8601. |
